But though He had done so many Miracles

Richard Crashaw (c. 1613–1649)

‘But though He had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not in Him.’—J
OHN
 
XII.
 37
.
F
OR
 all Thy signs they shall refuse Thee, Lord;
Those signs blest symbols of Thy reign and word.
Such signs and not believe? Sure, who did thus
Made unbelief itself miraculous.
